verdict.rationale: SLOs with error budgets and burn-rate alerts are a fair question for an application-monitoring platform like Sentry, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents issue-based alert rules (notifications, tickets, webhooks) and health dashboards. Nothing in the pack mentions defining SLOs, error budgets, or burn-rate alerting, and generic alerts are an adjacent feature that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can define SLOs with error budgets and burn-rate alerts
